profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Amazon | Agentic AI & Backend Systems | Open to relocation: California, Texas, UK, or Remote
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 19+ years of experience delivering large-scale distributed systems, identity and payment platforms, and production AI agents, with a focus on technical leadership, cross-team collaboration, and mentoring.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (SDE III/L6)
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Agentic & Gen AI: Rescued an abandoned chatbot (Creator Assistant), then rebuilt it as a RAG-based agentic service on AgentCore: ingested hundreds of multilingual Creator University documents into Amazon Kendra for semantic retrieval with metadata filtering and reranking, returning grounded, cited answers. It now serves 10K+ prompts daily and resolves 74% of Amazon Associates questions without human escalation, with answers evaluated via LLM-as-a-Judge.

- Ad Monitoring: Designed amp; built Supply Monitoring Tool, giving ad operations a single view to diagnose supply delivery across Data Management Platforms for Prime Video SVOD inventory and deals volume (1M+ hourly).

- Identity Migration: Technically led and mentored 8+ developers in a multi-year, shadow-mode migration of 500K Marvel users and 4M+ legacy Comixology accounts to Amazonrsquo;s AuthPortal Account Pool.

- Account Merge: Architected a full-stack self-service tool across multiple internal services and teams, migrating 6M+ users and their digital libraries to enable seamless eBook access across all Amazon surfaces.

- Operations: Overhauled on-call, cutting ticket volume by 50%+; top team ticket resolver, closing 30%+ of all tickets.

- Digital Payment Systems: Launched Partial Refunds, a Monitoring migration, and Dynamic Configuration integration with zero customer-impacting incidents.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed in-house XSD data-driven content editor (C#/WPF): UI Tree, Migrator, Audio, Exporter, & IoC container.

- Designed & developed dynamic dungeon generation for game server with editor support for Lineage Eternal.

- Technology sharing liaison for Arena.net; integrated Arena’s audio engine (C/C++) & editor (C#/WPF) for LE.

positions.title: Software Researcher
positions.description:
- Technical lead & architect for TAU Mobile Multi-touch UI JavaScript Framework.

- Delivered country-wide analytics web service in 3 months; iOS WebView client for accessing native resources.

positions.title: Senior Researcher
positions.description:
- Primary code-committer for ProPortal 3.0/4.0 (JSR168/286): Java, Servlet, JSF, & JavaScript.

- Awarded company-wide outstanding developer for the month of August, 2008 (500+ SDEs).
